context: Security must be fail-closed before any physical pilot or LAN packaging. When not on loopback, Locaily must refuse to run unless auth and allowlists are intentional. Prefer hard refuse over log warnings.
acceptance: Non-loopback without auth/LAN config refuses startup
LAN-mode unauthenticated relay calls fail in tests
constraints: Do not expose Local Brain to public network by default
Relay nodes remain execution targets only, not control planes
Prefer extending existing relay auth modules over new frameworks
